description: Left the cat on the settle and did not ask how the play went.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Fed him soft food and forbade an errand up to the Theatre.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Ate, and did not make his trade into a lesson.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Stayed in, kept the cap, and did not send for news.
name: William Shakespeare
